subject: astronomy
title: Phases & Tides: Using the Moon
welcome_lead: Sailors, fishers and rock-poolers have used the Moon for centuries — let's see how.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: tide tables, beach safety, lunar calendar.
final_note: Knowing the tide can save lives and find treasures.

walkthroughs.body_html: A tide table lists predicted high and low tide times for each port. Use one before a beach walk so the sea doesn't surprise you.
Many cultures use a lunar calendar. Islamic, Hebrew and Chinese calendars all use moon cycles to set months.
Where the tidal range is large (like the Severn Estuary), turbines can make electricity from moving water — clean and predictable.
